title: MV How to disable the SV cheering animation?

posts.author: LewyyM
posts.body: The post-battle cheering animation seriously doesn't fit the tone for me and I wanna disable it, but I don't know how to

posts.author: Niniann
posts.body:
Greetings,
All you would do here is take your battler spritesheet and change the cheering animation to whatever you wish.
If you don't want to draw a custom one, you can always copy the normal "bouncing" animation characters do in place of the cheering one.
Should be easy enough for ya to find, just open up the SV battler's battle spritesheet and locate the cheering animation, delete what is there, and paste the "bouncing/waiting" animation in its place.
Edit: Keep in mind you must have *something* there or the characters will vanish during the battle victory section of the battle scene, haha.
Happy game making,
-Niniann

Help (F1) > Documentation > Side-View Character Standards
